overview: TBah is a bold, mobile-first e-commerce platform for Gen Z. Features multi-seller support, a "Try At Home" experience, category-driven shopping with box-opening effects, customer order management, coupon discounts, a models showcase, and a full admin panel.
features: Multi-seller marketplace with order accept/reject and delivery choice
Category shopping with box-opening accordion effect (Men, Women, Handicrafts, Other)
Coupon system with discount amount shown at checkout
Models showcase gallery with single-photo full-width display
Customer login and order history with cancel anytime
Admin panel: manage sellers, products, coupons, trending, models
Cash on delivery with immediate order placement
Image performance: lazy loading, skeleton placeholders, persistent cache
